description: This file defines the IRDKWindowManager interface and its nested INotification interface, including methods for window management, application state notifications, input handling, and rendering control within the WPEFramework's Exchange namespace.

classes.name: IRDKWindowManager
classes.description: Interface for managing window and application notifications, input, and rendering in the WPEFramework.

classes.name: IRDKWindowManager::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for application and window events such as focus, visibility, connection, disconnection, and user inactivity.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window manager with the service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the window manager.

methods.name: CreateDisplay
methods.description: Creates a display window with specified parameters.

methods.name: GetApps
methods.description: Retrieves the list of active applications.

methods.name: AddKeyIntercept
methods.description: Registers a key intercept for a specific key code and client.

methods.name: AddKeyIntercepts
methods.description: Registers multiple key intercepts.

methods.name: RemoveKeyIntercept
methods.description: Removes a key intercept.

methods.name: AddKeyListener
methods.description: Registers key listeners.

methods.name: RemoveKeyListener
methods.description: Removes key listeners.

methods.name: InjectKey
methods.description: Simulates a key press event.

methods.name: GenerateKey
methods.description: Generates a key event for specified keys.

methods.name: EnableInactivityReporting
methods.description: Enables or disables inactivity reporting.

methods.name: SetInactivityInterval
methods.description: Sets the inactivity interval.

methods.name: ResetInactivityTime
methods.description: Resets inactivity timer.

methods.name: EnableKeyRepeats
methods.description: Enables or disables key repeats.

methods.name: GetKeyRepeatsEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves whether key repeats are enabled.

methods.name: IgnoreKeyInputs
methods.description: Sets whether key inputs are ignored.

methods.name: EnableInputEvents
methods.description: Enables input events for specified clients.

methods.name: KeyRepeatConfig
methods.description: Configures key repeat settings.

methods.name: SetFocus
methods.description: Sets focus to a specified application.

methods.name: SetVisible
methods.description: Sets visibility of a client or application.

methods.name: RenderReady
methods.description: Checks if the first frame of an application is rendered.

methods.name: EnableDisplayRender
methods.description: Enables or disables Wayland display rendering.

methods.name: GetLastKeyInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info about the last key press event.
